Key events37m agoUS delaying delivery of much-needed Patriot air defence missiles - media report47m agoMorning opening: Poland investigating (another) brief airspace violation by Russian drone A Polish police officer stands near a drone fragment in Czesniki,  Poland, in September 2025 following a previous incursion Photograph: Polsat News/ReutersView image in fullscreenA Polish police officer stands near a drone fragment in Czesniki,  Poland, in September 2025 following a previous incursion Photograph: Polsat News/ReutersJakub KrupaTue 24 Nov 2026 08.42 GMTFirst published on Tue 24 Nov 2026 08.32 GMTShareKey events37m agoUS delaying delivery of much-needed Patriot air defence missiles - media report47m agoMorning opening: Poland investigating (another) brief airspace violation by Russian drone37m ago08.42 GMTUS delaying delivery of much-needed Patriot air defence missiles - media reportMeanwhile, the Financial Times is reporting this morning that the Pentagon is delaying the delivery of about 60 much-needed Patriot air defence interceptors to Ukraine.

View image in fullscreenUkrainian service members walk next to a launcher of a Patriot air defence system, amid Russia's attack on Ukraine, in an undisclosed location, Ukraine. Photograph: Valentyn Ogirenko/ReutersThe interceptors, paid for by Ukraine’s western allies, are reportedly being held up by the US defence secretary, Pete Hegseth, who needs to sign off on their re-export, three people told the newspaper.

Ukraine’s president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, has repeatedly warned of the urgent need for more air defence missiles to protect the skies above Ukraine as the country braces for a difficult winter, with Russia continuing its strikes on critical civilian infrastructure.

47m ago08.32 GMTMorning opening: Poland investigating (another) brief airspace violation by Russian droneJakub KrupaA suspected Russian drone briefly entered Polish airspace during strikes on western Ukraine on Monday night in what authorities have described as “intentional activity” by Moscow – just days after three cruise missiles fell in Poland during a major attack on Ukraine.

The drone, believed to be carrying surveillance equipment, remained in Polish airspace for eight minutes before flying back to Ukraine.

Poland’s deputy defence minister, Paweł Zalewski, told RMF24 that the military decided against shooting it down because of risks to civilian properties in the area.

The incident took place just hours after Nato held emergency talks over last week’s airspace breach, authorising the deployment of a Nato Airborne Warning and Control System, AWACS, aircraft to Poland.

It also comes amid growing tensions between Russia and countries on the eastern flank of Nato, with Moscow making unsubstantiated accusations against Estonia warning that it’s acting ‘on verge of unleashing open war,” and a growing diplomatic spat with Finland.

Overnight, at least two people were killed and 40 injured in Russian attacks on the Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia ⁠overnight, with further attacks reported in the Sumy region.

I will keep an eye on this for you.

It’s Tuesday, 24 November 2026, it’s Jakub Krupa here, and this is Europe Live.
